title: Your Customer Testimonials Only Sell in One Language — Fix That
description: A great testimonial builds trust, but only for viewers who speak its language. Dubbing turns one happy customer into global social proof.
excerpt: A glowing testimonial is your best sales asset — and it's stuck in one language. Dubbing lets it build trust in every market you sell to.
content:
Nothing sells like a real customer saying your product changed something for them. Testimonial videos out-convert almost any ad you can make, because they carry trust an ad never will. But most brands accidentally cap that trust at one language.

**Trust does not translate through subtitles**

A testimonial works because it feels human and sincere. Slap subtitles on it and a foreign viewer is now reading instead of connecting — watching a stranger's mouth move while decoding text. The emotional weight that made the testimonial persuasive leaks away.

**Dub it and the trust travels**

[TubeVoice](https://tubevoice.io) dubs your testimonial into 50+ languages while preserving the speaker's tone and timing. A German or Spanish prospect hears the same warmth and conviction in their own language. The social proof lands the way it was meant to.

**One testimonial, many markets**

This compounds fast. You spent effort getting one customer to record a great testimonial. Dubbed into five languages, that single clip now builds trust on your German, French, Spanish, Polish, and Czech landing pages — from one recording. Your best social proof stops being locked to one audience.

**Where to start**

Take the testimonial that already converts best in your home market. Dub it into the two or three languages where you get traffic but weaker conversion — often the gap is simply that visitors did not fully trust content in a language that was not theirs. Measure the change. Localized social proof frequently lifts conversion more than any new ad creative.

Your happiest customers already made your best marketing. Dubbing just lets everyone understand them.
